periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: The primary axes of the eye patches are angled approximately 45 degrees inward toward the nasal bridge relative to the horizontal plane.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: The patches exhibit an elongated oval morphology with a vertical-to-horizontal aspect ratio of approximately 1.5:1.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: There is a distinct downward tapering towards the snout, creating a teardrop-shaped extension below the geometric center of the patch.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: The ears are widely set at the upper lateral corners of the cranium, separated by a distance roughly 1.5 times the width of a single ear.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: The superior boundaries of the pinnae exhibit a smooth, continuous convex curvature.

other_distinctive_markers: Visible mandibular dentition (lower teeth) and prominent dark claws on the right forelimb are clearly observable during feeding behavior.
